summary: Project to build/deploy a web app that can open a live camera feed; current blocker is a failed build/deployment.
known_issues: Build/deployment currently failing, preventing the live camera feature from running

existing_features.title: Fix any TypeScript DOM typing issues in `useMediaRecorder` that can break the frontend build in a browser-only React project (e.g., avoid using `NodeJS.Timeout` for `setInterval` in the browser) so the hook type-checks cleanly.

new_feature_requests.summary: Enable opening and displaying a live camera feed in the app

Fix the frontend build error preventing deployment by resolving the missing import used by the camera recording UI (the hook imported as `@/camera/useCamera`). Add the missing `useCamera` hook/module (or update the import to a real existing module) so the app compiles and the Live page can render the Camera Recording tab.

Implement camera start/stop behavior in the `useCamera` hook so that clicking "Enable Camera" requests permissions via `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`, attaches the stream to the provided `videoRef`, and surfaces user-friendly errors for common failures (permission denied, no camera device found, not supported).

projectName: Fix build/deployment failure and restore Live camera capture/recording
